title: campanula rotundifolia subsp. stenocodon
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subsp. stenocodon, commonly known as Scottish bluebell, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family. This plant is known for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Campanula rotundifolia subsp. stenocodon include its ability to act as a sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
